# Taxonomy of Grid-Based Logic Puzzles

## 1. Number Placement Puzzles
*(Fill cells with numbers according to constraints)*
- Sudoku
- Fillomino
- Ripple Effect
- Makaro
- Nansuke
- Hebi

## 2. Region Division Puzzles
*(Partition the grid into defined areas or shapes)*
- Shikaku
- Five Cells
- Sashigane
- Double Choco
- Choco Banana
- Nuritwin
- Sto-stone

## 3. Cell Shading Puzzles
*(Determine which cells to colour black or grey)*
- Nurikabe
- Hitori
- Heyawake
- Kurodoko
- Kurotto
- Usowan
- LITS
- Norinori
- Tilepaint
- Chained Block
- Shakashaka

## 4. Single Loop Puzzles
*(Draw one continuous closed loop through the grid)*
- Slitherlink
- Masyu
- Yajilin
- Nagareru
- Moon-or-Sun
- Mid-loop
- Dotchi-Loop
- Suraromu

## 5. Path and Connection Puzzles
*(Connect elements or trace directed paths)*
- Hashiwokakero
- Numberlink
- Nurimeizu
- Pencils
- Evolomino

## 6. Object Placement Puzzles
*(Place specific objects or symbols into the grid)*
- Akari
- Juosan
- Nurimisaki
- Yosenabe
- Satogaeri

## 7. Region Marking / Block Identification Puzzles
*(Identify or mark blocks and regions satisfying structural constraints)*
- Ripple Effect *(moved — see Note)*
- Sto-stone *(moved — see Note)*
